brief.meaningEn: In the mind context, be full of active thoughts or ideas.
brief.meaningZh: 在形容頭腦時，滿是活躍的思緒或構思。
brief.grammar: my mind is buzzing with ideas/questions; buzzed in past; with names what fills the mind.
brief.register: Conventional sound metaphor for lively mental activity. This lesson focuses on mind/thoughts, not a literal insect sound or a venue’s busy atmosphere.
brief.boundaryZh: 想法多不表示每個都好、已整理或一定焦慮；要看內容與語氣，不用片語作診斷。
brief.misconceptionZh: 構思活躍與已作決定不同，仍可需記錄及比較。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述想法湧現，保留整理及篩選的需要。

listening.en: My mind was buzzing with ideas after the design talk, so I wrote them down before choosing which one to develop.
listening.zh: 設計講座後，我腦中滿是構思，所以先記下，再選發展哪個。
listening.promptZh: 講座後，說話者處於甚麼階段？

options.en: Many ideas were active, but a choice had not yet been made.
options.zh: 很多構思活躍，但尚未選定。

options.en: One final design had already been completed and tested.
options.zh: 一個最終設計已完成測試。

options.en: There were no thoughts to record after the talk.
options.zh: 講座後沒有想法可記。

options.en: The speaker rejected the ideas before considering any of them.
options.zh: 說話者未考慮任何想法便全拒。

listening.explanationZh: 先記下再選，表示構思多與定案分開。

reply.promptZh: 設計講座後，你為甚麼立即記筆記？
reply.promptEn: Why did you make notes immediately after the design talk?

options.en: There were many ideas I wanted to capture before selecting one.
options.zh: 有很多構思想先記下，再選一個。

options.en: My mind was buzzing with ideas that I had not yet sorted.
options.zh: 我腦中滿是尚未整理的構思。

options.en: I wanted to record the possibilities while they were fresh.
options.zh: 我想趁可能方案還清晰時記下。

options.en: Writing them down would help me compare the different directions.
options.zh: 記下它們會幫我比較不同方向。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都解釋記錄活躍構思，不代表已定案。

scene.promptZh: 你讀完一個故事，腦中有很多問題與不同結局，想先記下再決定寫甚麼。哪句合適？

options.en: My mind is buzzing with possibilities for the ending.
options.zh: 我腦中滿是結局的可能方向。

options.en: Every possible ending has already been tested with readers.
options.zh: 每個可能結局都已找讀者測試。

options.en: I have no questions or ideas after reading.
options.zh: 讀後我沒有問題或構思。

scene.explanationZh: 很多可能方向是活躍思緒，不是已測試全部。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜單憑 a mind buzzing with ideas 得出？

options.en: Many ideas are occupying the person’s thoughts.
options.zh: 很多構思佔據當事人的思緒。

options.en: Every idea is already suitable and needs no comparison.
options.zh: 每個構思都已合適，不需比較。

options.en: The person may want to record and organise the thoughts.
options.zh: 當事人可能想記錄及整理思緒。

contrast.explanationZh: 量多不決定質素，仍需篩選。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴因構思很多，就想未查可行性直接宣稱每個都可用。哪句建議較準確？

options.en: Keep the energy, but compare the ideas against the project’s needs before selecting them.
options.zh: 保留活力，但選用前需對照項目需要比較構思。

options.en: Choose the first attractive idea now and check the project’s requirements after developing it.
options.zh: 現在先選首個吸引構思，發展後才查項目要求。

options.en: Develop the ideas together straight away rather than decide which one best fits the brief.
options.zh: 立即同時發展那些構思，不先決定哪個最合要求。

dialogue.explanationZh: 題目要先查可行性；應以需要篩選，不先投入首個吸引構思，也不未排優次就同時發展。

speaking.en: My mind is buzzing with ideas, and I want to compare them before choosing a direction.
speaking.zh: 我腦中滿是構思，想比較後再選方向。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把思緒活躍與選擇連起來。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你聽完祖母講一段旅途，想到很多可問的細節與可整理的家史線索，但不想一次打斷她問完。用一至兩句英文描述腦中想法，並說明先記下再選追問。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以故事後湧現問題及家史構思說明活躍，提出記錄篩選，不把所有想問都當須立即問完。

examples.en: My mind is buzzing with questions after my grandmother’s story, so I will note them down and choose one thoughtful follow-up.
examples.zh: 聽祖母故事後，我腦中滿是問題，所以會記下，再選一個深思過的追問。

examples.en: I am buzzing with ideas for the family history, but I want to organise the questions before interrupting her account.
examples.zh: 我滿是家史構思，但想先整理問題，再打斷她的敘述。

takeaways.en: Her mind was buzzing with possibilities after the rehearsal, so she saved a few notes for the next discussion.
takeaways.zh: 排練後她腦中滿是可能方向，所以存幾則筆記留待下次討論。

takeaways.en: I was buzzing with questions but had not yet decided which one to ask first.
takeaways.zh: 我腦中滿是問題，但尚未決定先問哪個。

brief.meaningEn: Relax after a period of work, pressure or tension.
brief.meaningZh: 一段工作、壓力或緊張後放鬆。
brief.grammar: unwind after + work/event; unwind by + -ing; past unwound, not unwinded.
brief.register: Established relaxation sense of a verb whose literal sense involves uncoiling. It is not a phrasal verb.
brief.boundaryZh: 放鬆不等於忘掉一切、取消責任或保證某種活動對所有人有效；需看個人情境。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可描述所感放鬆，不憑片語推斷醫療原因或處理方式。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明個人的放鬆經驗，配合正確詞形及時間。

listening.en: After the busy workshop, I unwound by sketching quietly for a while, once the materials were packed and the handover was complete.
listening.zh: 繁忙工作坊後，材料收好、交接完成，我安靜畫了一會放鬆。
listening.promptZh: 說話者甚麼時候、怎樣放鬆？

options.en: After the agreed closing tasks, through quiet sketching.
options.zh: 在議定收尾工作後，透過安靜畫畫。

options.en: By sketching during the handover while the materials were still waiting to be packed.
options.zh: 在材料仍待收好、交接仍進行時畫畫。

options.en: During the handover, by leaving without telling anyone.
options.zh: 在交接中，不通知就走。

options.en: By continuing to revise the workshop materials rather than taking a quiet drawing break.
options.zh: 繼續修改工作坊材料，而非安靜畫畫小休。

listening.explanationZh: once packed及handover complete指出收尾完成後；sketching是放鬆活動，不是交接中先走，或繼續修改工作。

reply.promptZh: 工作坊收尾完成後，你怎樣度過一小段時間？
reply.promptEn: How did you spend a little time after the workshop was closed up?

options.en: I sketched quietly to relax after the busy session.
options.zh: 繁忙時段後，我安靜畫畫放鬆。

options.en: I unwound with some quiet sketching.
options.zh: 我安靜畫畫，讓自己放鬆。

options.en: I gave myself a calm break once everything was packed.
options.zh: 全部收好後，我給自己平靜小休。

options.en: A little drawing helped me let go of the workshop’s pressure for a while.
options.zh: 畫一會幫我暫放工作坊壓力。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述個人放鬆，金句正確過去式 unwound。

scene.promptZh: 完成忙碌排練後，角色在故事中與朋友閒聊，漸漸不再那麼繃緊。哪句貼切？

options.en: She unwound by chatting with her friends after rehearsal.
options.zh: 她排練後和朋友聊天，逐漸放鬆。

options.en: Talking afterwards proves the rehearsal never felt demanding.
options.zh: 之後聊天證明排練從未有壓力。

options.en: She unwound the cable; the sentence is only about putting equipment away.
options.zh: 她解開捲線；句子只關收拾設備。

scene.explanationZh: 情境明示不再繃緊，是放鬆而非實際解線。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論最不宜只憑 someone unwound 得出？

options.en: The person relaxed after some tension or effort.
options.zh: 當事人在緊張或投入後放鬆。

options.en: The person’s chosen activity must relax everybody equally.
options.zh: 當事人所選活動必定令每人同樣放鬆。

options.en: Context can explain the activity and when it happened.
options.zh: 情境可解釋活動及發生時間。

contrast.explanationZh: 個人經驗不能保證人人相同。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴以為只有獨處才可 unwind，但你已知故事人物與朋友閒聊後覺得放鬆。哪句較準確？

options.en: Use the person’s experience to describe the relaxation rather than requiring one setting for everyone.
options.zh: 按當事人經驗描述放鬆，而非要求人人同一環境。

options.en: Reject the reported relaxation because another person was present.
options.zh: 因另有人在場，就否定已報告的放鬆。

options.en: Change the account to solitary reading without asking what actually happened.
options.zh: 未問實際情況，就改寫成獨自讀書。

dialogue.explanationZh: 放鬆方式可不同，應忠於已給經驗。

speaking.en: I unwound after the session in a way that worked for me, once the agreed tasks were done.
speaking.zh: 議定工作完成後，我用適合自己的方式放鬆。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再保留個人方式及收尾時點。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫旅行故事，人物原想工作後放鬆，車站卻突然改月台，令她繼續繃緊；找到正確列車並坐下後才漸漸放鬆。用一至兩句英文交代想放鬆與實際放鬆的先後。
writing.selfCheckZh: 分清想放鬆、月台改動仍繃緊及找到車後才放鬆的時間線，不把工作已完直接當情緒已放鬆。

examples.en: She hoped to unwind after work, but the platform change kept her alert. Only after finding the right train did she begin to relax.
examples.zh: 她原想工作後放鬆，但更改月台令她繼續繃緊。找到正確列車後，她才開始放鬆。

examples.en: She unwound once she was seated on the right train, rather than as soon as the workday ended.
examples.zh: 她坐上正確列車後才放鬆，而非工作天一結束就立即放鬆。

takeaways.en: He unwound with a familiar song after finishing the event notes.
takeaways.zh: 完成活動筆記後，他聽熟悉歌曲放鬆。

takeaways.en: The group had time to unwind after the final handover.
takeaways.zh: 最後交接後，小組有時間放鬆。

brief.meaningEn: A gentle ending or transition that makes a change feel less abrupt or difficult.
brief.meaningZh: 較溫和的結束或過渡，令改變不那麼突然或困難。
brief.grammar: give/provide someone with a soft landing; a soft landing after/from + demanding activity; specify the transition.
brief.register: Conventional landing metaphor; this lesson is everyday transitions, not economic forecasting or literal aircraft landing.
brief.boundaryZh: 平緩不等於完全沒困難、沒有下一步或所有工作已完；需交代過渡怎樣有緩衝。
brief.misconceptionZh: 一句安慰未必構成有效緩衝，要看安排與當事人體驗。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述具體緩衝安排，保留轉變仍需適應。

sources.sentence: A quiet walk gave the busy day a soft landing.

listening.en: A short debrief and a quiet walk gave the team a soft landing after the intense performance, before everyone returned to ordinary routines.
listening.zh: 緊湊演出後，簡短回顧與安靜散步給團隊平緩過渡，再各自回日常。
listening.promptZh: a soft landing 連結哪兩個階段？

options.en: The intense performance and the return to ordinary routines.
options.zh: 緊湊演出與回到日常。

options.en: The first rehearsal and a performance that had not begun.
options.zh: 首次排練與尚未開始的演出。

options.en: The return to ordinary routines before the intense performance began.
options.zh: 緊湊演出開始前，先回到日常。

options.en: The team’s preparation for the next intense rehearsal, rather than its return to ordinary routines.
options.zh: 團隊為下次緊湊排練準備，而非回到日常。

listening.explanationZh: after performance及before routines連結演出後與回日常；不是演出前，也不是往下一次緊湊排練的準備。

reply.promptZh: 演出後的回顧及散步對團隊有甚麼作用？
reply.promptEn: What did the debrief and walk do for the team after the performance?

options.en: They made the return to ordinary routines feel less abrupt.
options.zh: 它們令回日常不那麼突然。

options.en: They gave us a soft landing after the intense performance.
options.zh: 緊湊演出後，它們給我們平緩過渡。

options.en: We had a gentle way to close the event before moving on.
options.zh: 繼續之前，我們有溫和方式結束活動。

options.en: The short transition helped us leave the performance’s intensity behind.
options.zh: 短過渡幫我們離開演出緊湊感。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都解釋緩衝作用，不保證此後完全沒難處。

scene.promptZh: 長期項目結束時，小組先整理成果、互相致謝及說明下一周安排，再分開工作。哪句合適？

options.en: The closing session offered a soft landing after the long project.
options.zh: 收尾環節為長期項目後提供平緩過渡。

options.en: The session introduced the project’s aims before the long period of work began.
options.zh: 環節在長期工作開始前介紹項目目標。

options.en: The project ended without any transition or explanation of what came next.
options.zh: 項目沒有任何過渡或下一步解釋就結束。

scene.explanationZh: 整理成果、致謝及下一周安排，為項目結束提供緩衝，不是工作前介紹，亦不是沒有過渡。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 an everyday soft landing？

options.en: A clear handover and gradual return after an intense event.
options.zh: 緊湊活動後清楚交接及逐漸返回。

options.en: An abrupt unexplained change that leaves the person unsure what to do next.
options.zh: 突然且沒解釋的改變，令人不知下一步。

options.en: A short transition that helps people understand the change.
options.zh: 幫大家理解改變的短過渡。

contrast.explanationZh: 突變又沒有方向，未提供平緩緩衝。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想只說「別緊張」就稱過渡很平緩，新成員其實還不知道去哪裏及問誰。哪句建議最好？

options.en: Add clear next steps and a contact person rather than relying only on reassurance.
options.zh: 加清楚下一步及聯絡人，不只靠安慰。

options.en: Treat the reassuring words as proof that the practical questions are answered.
options.zh: 把安慰說話當實際問題已答的證據。

options.en: Remove the contact information so the transition feels less formal.
options.zh: 為讓過渡不那麼正式，刪聯絡資料。

dialogue.explanationZh: 緩衝應回應實際需要，不只把安心語當已解困難。

speaking.en: The handover gave us a soft landing, though the new routine still took time to learn.
speaking.zh: 交接給我們平緩過渡，但新日常仍需時間學。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再肯定緩衝並保留適應。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：同伴一學期在外交流後回到社團，沒有立刻承擔整晚活動，而是首周先負責一小段，再一起檢視工作量，逐步恢復原有責任。你想說明這個工作量緩衝安排，仍需看她適應情況。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以初期較小工作量及檢視後逐步增加描述回歸緩衝，不把緩衝當已完全適應或永久減責。

examples.en: A small first assignment gives her a soft landing as she returns to the club. We will review the workload together before adding the rest of her duties.
examples.zh: 回社團時，首項小任務給她平緩過渡。我們會先一起檢視工作量，再加其餘責任。

examples.en: We want to offer a soft landing by starting with one part of the evening rather than a full programme. Her responsibilities can grow after the first review.
examples.zh: 我們想先讓她負責晚會一部分，而非整場，以提供平緩過渡。首次檢視後再增加責任。

takeaways.en: The final check-in gave the group a soft landing after weeks of preparation.
takeaways.zh: 幾周準備後，最後一次聯絡讓小組平緩收尾。

takeaways.en: A clear introduction offered her a soft landing into the unfamiliar routine.
takeaways.zh: 清楚介紹為她進入陌生日常提供平緩過渡。

titleEn: at the end of the day

brief.meaningEn: When everything relevant has been considered, introducing the main point or priority.
brief.meaningZh: 考慮相關事情後，引出最主要的重點或優先事項。
brief.grammar: At the end of the day, + concluding point; conversational summarising use, not necessarily evening.
brief.register: Common conversational idiom; can sound overused, so support the conclusion with reasons.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是一說便結束討論、證明結論或取消其他因素；字面一天結尾需按情境另判。
brief.misconceptionZh: 它標示說話者認為重要的總結，不是論點本身的證據。
brief.outcomeZh: 能引出有理由的主要考慮，分清字面時刻與總結功能。

listening.en: We can debate the colour of the learning room, but at the end of the day the children need to hear the instructions and move around safely.
listening.zh: 我們可討論學習室顏色，但歸根究柢，孩子需要聽見指示及安全走動。
listening.promptZh: 這裏的表達有甚麼作用？

options.en: It introduces the practical priority after considering a design detail.
options.zh: 它在考慮設計細節後引出實際優先事項。

options.en: It says children only need instructions in the evening.
options.zh: 它說孩子只在晚上需指示。

options.en: It proves the speaker’s conclusion without needing any reasons.
options.zh: 它證明說話者結論，不需理由。

options.en: It states that room colour cannot be discussed at all.
options.zh: 它說房間顏色完全不能討論。

listening.explanationZh: but 後總結安全與聽指示為主要需要，非晚間條件或禁談顏色。

reply.promptZh: 比較不同設計時，你最想保留甚麼重點？
reply.promptEn: What point do you most want to keep in mind when comparing the designs?

options.en: The children must be able to hear and move safely.
options.zh: 孩子必須聽得到並安全走動。

options.en: At the end of the day, the room needs to work safely for the children.
options.zh: 歸根究柢，房間需讓孩子安全使用。

options.en: Practical access and clear instructions should guide the final choice.
options.zh: 實際可用及清楚指示應引導最後選擇。

options.en: Whatever colour we choose, the space has to support the children’s activities.
options.zh: 不論選甚麼顏色，空間需支援孩子活動。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都表達主要考慮，金句不是時間安排。

scene.promptZh: 大家比較借書系統的版面，但你想總結主要目標仍是讓人找到及借到書，不限定晚上。哪句合適？

options.en: At the end of the day, readers need to find and borrow the books.
options.zh: 歸根究柢，讀者需找到及借到書。

options.en: The phrase means readers may borrow only at closing time.
options.zh: 片語表示讀者只可關門時借書。

options.en: At the end of the day, the page decoration should decide the choice even if readers cannot find the borrowing steps.
options.zh: 歸根究柢，即使讀者找不到借書步驟，也應由頁面裝飾決定選擇。

scene.explanationZh: 情境指定主要目標是找到及借書，不是日末時限，也不是以裝飾壓過借閱需要。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以由這個總結用法得出？

options.en: The speaker is introducing what they consider the main issue.
options.zh: 說話者引出自己認為主要的問題。

options.en: The next claim is automatically correct because the phrase precedes it.
options.zh: 下一個主張因前有此片語就自動正確。

options.en: The phrase may not refer to an actual time of day.
options.zh: 片語可能不指實際一天時刻。

contrast.explanationZh: 總結標記不是證據。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說「at the end of the day，我會選漂亮的藍色房間」，但還未查孩子能否清楚聽指示及安全走動。哪個回應最有幫助？

options.en: That states your preference, but we should check the children’s access and listening needs before making the final choice.
options.zh: 那說明你的偏好，但最後選擇前應查孩子的通行及聆聽需要。

options.en: Then we can settle on the blue room now and consider the layout only after booking it.
options.zh: 那我們現在可定藍房，訂下後才考慮布局。

options.en: The blue room’s listening conditions are suitable; its appearance is what we still need to compare.
options.zh: 藍房聆聽條件已合適；我們仍需比較的是外觀。

dialogue.explanationZh: 總結偏好仍需相關依據；聲學及通行未查，不能當已比較，亦不宜先訂才查主要需要。

speaking.en: At the end of the day, we need a plan that fits the task, and we should explain why it does.
speaking.zh: 歸根究柢，我們需合任務的計劃，也應解釋為何合適。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再以理由支持主要結論。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你選一份給祖母的紀念禮物，同伴只看外盒是否華麗；你認為能讓她清楚看見家人照片、想起共同經歷更重要。用一至兩句英文總結主要目標，不說價格或外觀永遠無關。
writing.selfCheckZh: 把照片與回憶目標作結論並交代理由，不把總結標記當證據，也不需否定所有外觀考慮。

examples.en: At the end of the day, the gift should help her enjoy the family photographs and memories. We should choose a clear layout rather than judge only the box.
examples.zh: 歸根究柢，禮物應讓她欣賞家人照片與回憶。我們應選清楚版面，而非只看外盒。

examples.en: The packaging matters, but at the end of the day I want the photographs to be easy for her to see and share.
examples.zh: 包裝有作用，但歸根究柢，我想照片讓她容易看及分享。

glossary.en: easy for her to see and share

takeaways.en: At the end of the day, the guide should help visitors find the entrance without confusion.
takeaways.zh: 歸根究柢，指南應幫訪客不混亂地找到入口。

takeaways.en: We considered several formats, but at the end of the day the text had to be readable.
takeaways.zh: 我們考慮幾種格式，但歸根究柢，文字需容易閱讀。

brief.meaningEn: Become able to think more calmly or clearly after stress, confusion or distraction.
brief.meaningZh: 在壓力、混亂或干擾後，較能冷靜或清晰思考。
brief.grammar: clear my/your/her head; clear their heads; cleared in past; state the particular experience, not a universal treatment.
brief.register: Conventional head-as-thinking expression; not literally emptying the head or deleting memories.
brief.boundaryZh: 較清晰不表示已知道正確答案、解決問題或忘掉一切；同一方式也未必適合每人。
brief.misconceptionZh: 分清思考狀態與實際決定，不能把冷靜感當論點正確的證據。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述思緒改善及再看問題的安排，保留查證。

listening.en: I stepped away from the noisy planning table to clear my head, then returned to compare the two options rather than choosing while flustered.
listening.zh: 我離開吵雜策劃桌，讓思緒冷靜清晰，再返回比較兩個選項，而非慌亂時決定。
listening.promptZh: 離開一會有甚麼目的？

options.en: To think more calmly before returning to compare the options.
options.zh: 較冷靜思考，再返回比較選項。

options.en: To draft and submit a choice during the break instead of returning to the group.
options.zh: 在小休期間擬稿提交選擇，而非回小組。

options.en: To postpone the comparison until another day after leaving the session.
options.zh: 離開環節後，把比較延到另一天。

options.en: To compare the options while staying at the noisy table.
options.zh: 留在吵雜桌旁比較選項。

listening.explanationZh: 離開讓思緒較冷靜，then returned compare說當次回來比較；不是休息中先提交、延後到另日或留原桌。

reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼先離開策劃桌一會？
reply.promptEn: Why did you leave the planning table briefly?

options.en: I wanted to think calmly before comparing the options.
options.zh: 我想先冷靜思考再比較選項。

options.en: I needed to clear my head before making the choice.
options.zh: 作選擇前，我需讓思緒冷靜清晰。

options.en: I was flustered and wanted to return with a clearer view of the problem.
options.zh: 我很慌亂，想返回時較清楚看問題。

options.en: A short pause gave me space to reconsider rather than react immediately.
options.zh: 短暫停頓給我重新考慮空間，而非立即反應。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都解釋改善思考狀態，不把停頓當已有答案。

scene.promptZh: 你讀了幾份互相矛盾的評語後很混亂，整理短筆記讓自己較冷靜，然後再查哪項有根據。哪句合適？

options.en: Making a few notes helped clear my head before I checked the comments.
options.zh: 寫幾則筆記幫思緒清晰，再核對評語。

options.en: The notes helped me feel calmer after I had already checked the comments.
options.zh: 我已核對評語後，筆記才幫我較冷靜。

options.en: I chose the suggestion that sounded best at first, without returning to compare the evidence.
options.zh: 我選最初聽來最好建議，沒回頭比較證據。

scene.explanationZh: 題目次序是先整理筆記、思緒較清晰，再查根據；不是查後才清晰，亦不是憑最初印象定案。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜單靠 cleared my head 得出？

options.en: The person felt able to think more calmly or clearly.
options.zh: 當事人覺得較能冷靜或清晰思考。

options.en: Every conclusion reached afterwards must be factually correct.
options.zh: 之後每個結論必定事實正確。

options.en: Context should explain what helped and what still needed deciding.
options.zh: 情境應說明甚麼有幫助、甚麼仍需決定。

contrast.explanationZh: 清晰感不能代替事實查證。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴休息後覺得清醒，就想不查資料直接提交結論。哪句較準確？

options.en: Use the clearer thinking to check the evidence before submitting.
options.zh: 用較清晰思考在提交前查證據。

options.en: Submit the conclusion now and compare the conflicting evidence after receiving a response.
options.zh: 現在先交結論，收到回應後才比衝突證據。

options.en: Use the option that felt most convincing before the break rather than reopen the comparison.
options.zh: 用小休前感覺最有說服力的選項，不重開比較。

dialogue.explanationZh: 清晰思考可用來完成未做的查核；不應先交後查，或只沿用小休前印象。

speaking.en: The pause helped clear my head, but I still need to check the evidence before deciding.
speaking.zh: 停頓幫我思緒清晰，但決定前仍需查證據。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清思緒與資料正確性。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你要回覆一封令你不快的社團訊息，先在未寄出的草稿列事實與想問的問題，思緒較清楚後再核對語氣與資料。用一至兩句英文描述，不把清醒當對方一定有錯。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以事實及問題整理說明清晰思考，保留核對語氣與資料，不因自己較冷靜就斷言對方錯或故意。

examples.en: Writing an unsent draft helped clear my head before I replied. I will check the facts and tone rather than assume my first reaction was right.
examples.zh: 寫未寄出的草稿幫我回覆前思緒清晰。我會查事實與語氣，不假定最初反應正確。

examples.en: I want to clear my head by separating the facts from my questions, then review the reply before sending it.
examples.zh: 我想把事實與問題分開，讓思緒清晰，再在寄出前檢視回覆。

takeaways.en: She paused to clear her head before comparing the two accounts.
takeaways.zh: 比較兩份敘述前，她停一會讓思緒清晰。

takeaways.en: A quiet moment helped clear my head, though the question still needed an answer.
takeaways.zh: 安靜一刻幫我思緒清晰，但問題仍需答案。

brief.meaningEn: Stay asleep until later in the morning than usual.
brief.meaningZh: 早上保持睡着，直到比平常較晚的時間。
brief.grammar: sleep in until + time / on + day; slept in in past. Compare with the person’s usual waking time.
brief.register: Common informal phrasal verb, dictionary-listed in British and American English.
brief.boundaryZh: 不等於晚上較晚才睡，也不只清醒躺床；不必指失約或個性懶惰。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要分開晚起、晚睡與睡過原定時間；是否誤事需看實際約定。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述相對平常較晚醒來，不加入沒有資料的性格或責任判斷。

listening.en: On Sunday I slept in until nine instead of my usual seven; our family lunch was at noon, so I had not missed the agreed meeting.
listening.zh: 周日我睡到九時，比平常七時晚；家庭午餐在中午，所以我沒錯過議定見面。
listening.promptZh: 哪個描述符合時間資料？

options.en: The speaker woke later than usual without missing the noon lunch.
options.zh: 說話者比平常晚醒，卻沒錯過中午午餐。

options.en: The speaker went to bed at nine rather than seven.
options.zh: 說話者九時而非七時上床。

options.en: The speaker was awake in bed from seven and did not sleep any longer.
options.zh: 說話者七時起已清醒躺床，沒有繼續睡。

options.en: The lunch had been agreed for seven, so the speaker missed it.
options.zh: 午餐議定七時，所以說話者錯過。

listening.explanationZh: until nine 與 usual seven 比醒來時間；中午午餐保留未失約。

reply.promptZh: 周日的早上與平常有甚麼不同？
reply.promptEn: How was Sunday morning different from your usual routine?

options.en: I woke at nine rather than my usual seven.
options.zh: 我九時醒，而非平常七時。

options.en: I slept in because the family lunch was not until noon.
options.zh: 因家庭午餐在中午，我早上多睡了一會。

options.en: I stayed asleep later but was still ready for the agreed lunch.
options.zh: 我較晚才醒，仍趕得及議定午餐。

options.en: My waking time was later than on an ordinary day.
options.zh: 我的醒來時間比平常日子晚。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都談早上較晚醒，不是晚上上床較晚。

scene.promptZh: 角色通常六時醒，假日八時才醒；你只知道醒來時間，未知昨晚何時上床。哪句準確？

options.en: She slept in compared with her usual routine.
options.zh: 她比平常早上多睡了一會。

options.en: She must have gone to bed exactly two hours later than usual.
options.zh: 她必定比平常遲恰好兩小時上床。

options.en: She was awake throughout the extra two hours.
options.zh: 額外兩小時她一直清醒。

scene.explanationZh: 可比醒來時間，不能反推上床時點或全程清醒。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以顯示 someone slept in？

options.en: They remained asleep beyond their normal waking time.
options.zh: 他保持睡着，超過平常醒來時間。

options.en: They woke later than usual on the free morning.
options.zh: 空閒早上他比平常晚醒。

options.en: They woke at the usual time and stayed awake reading in bed.
options.zh: 他平常時間醒，清醒在床讀書。

contrast.explanationZh: 本課重點是仍睡着，不只待床。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴只因你假日九時醒，就說你錯過七時會議，但當天根本沒約七時。哪句較準確？

options.en: Check the actual commitment before treating a later waking time as a missed appointment.
options.zh: 把晚醒當失約前，先查真正約定。

options.en: Use the usual waking time as if it were an agreed meeting.
options.zh: 把平常醒來時間當議定會議。

options.en: Assume every later morning wake-up means the person ignored a promise.
options.zh: 假定每次較晚醒都表示忽略承諾。

dialogue.explanationZh: 日常醒來時間與約定時間不同，需查有無實際失約。

speaking.en: I slept in until nine, but I was still ready for the time we had agreed.
speaking.zh: 我睡到九時，但仍趕得及議定時間。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把較晚醒與是否失約分開。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫旅行日記，原想清晨拍日出，平常六時醒，這天卻睡到八時，起來時日出已過。你想如實記下錯過拍攝，並約同伴翌晨先確認鬧鐘及出門時間，不猜晚睡原因。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 交代比平常晚醒及實際錯過日出的後果，提出翌晨確認安排，不從晚醒推上床時間或品格。

examples.en: I slept in until eight instead of waking at six and missed the chance to photograph the sunrise. Tomorrow we will check the alarm and agree when to leave.
examples.zh: 我睡到八時而非六時醒，錯過日出拍攝。明天我們會確認鬧鐘並議定出門時間。

examples.en: By the time I woke after sleeping in, the sunrise had passed. I will plan the next morning’s departure with my companion before we try again.
examples.zh: 我早上多睡後醒來時，日出已過。再試之前，我會與同伴安排翌晨出門。

takeaways.en: He slept in on the free morning and met us at the agreed afternoon time.
takeaways.zh: 空閒早上他多睡了一會，下午按議定時間見我們。

takeaways.en: She usually wakes early but slept in until eight that Sunday.
takeaways.zh: 她平常早醒，但那個周日睡到八時。

brief.meaningEn: Demanding enough in emotional terms to leave someone feeling exhausted.
brief.meaningZh: 情感上的要求很高，令人感到疲憊。
brief.grammar: find something emotionally draining; an emotionally draining experience; emotionally modifies draining.
brief.register: Natural descriptive collocation. It describes experienced emotional demand, not a medical diagnosis.
brief.boundaryZh: 不等於不值得、不關心或一定身體勞累；一段有意義經歷也可令人情緒疲憊。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不能因某人重視事情就說他不應累，也不從疲憊推斷病因或品格。
brief.outcomeZh: 能表達情緒負荷，同時保留經驗價值及需要的安排。

listening.en: Listening to several difficult personal accounts was emotionally draining for the volunteer, even though she valued the chance to understand the families.
listening.zh: 聽幾段艱難的個人經歷讓義工情緒上很疲憊，儘管她珍惜理解家庭的機會。
listening.promptZh: 疲憊與重視有甚麼關係？

options.en: The volunteer valued the experience and still felt emotionally exhausted.
options.zh: 義工重視經歷，仍感情緒疲憊。

options.en: Feeling tired proves she did not care about the families.
options.zh: 感到累證明她不關心家庭。

options.en: The account describes only heavy lifting, with no emotional demands.
options.zh: 敘述只描述搬重物，沒有情感要求。

options.en: The chance to understand the families removed all emotional strain.
options.zh: 理解家庭的機會消除所有情緒負荷。

listening.explanationZh: even though 保留重視與疲憊並存，非只身體活動。

reply.promptZh: 你怎樣描述那段聆聽經歷，而不否定其價值？
reply.promptEn: How would you describe the listening experience without dismissing its value?

options.en: It mattered to me, but the difficult accounts left me feeling exhausted.
options.zh: 它對我重要，但艱難敘述令我疲憊。

options.en: It was emotionally draining, even though I valued listening to the families.
options.zh: 它讓我情緒上很疲憊，儘管我珍惜聆聽家庭。

options.en: I appreciated the chance to understand them and still needed a pause afterwards.
options.zh: 我珍惜理解機會，之後仍需停一會。

options.en: The emotional demands were high, without making the experience meaningless.
options.zh: 情緒要求很高，卻不令經歷沒意義。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都分清負荷與價值，不把累當不關心。

scene.promptZh: 故事人物整天處理同伴衝突，需要細聽及照顧不同感受，晚上覺情緒疲憊，但仍重視這工作。哪句合適？

options.en: She found the conflict work emotionally draining but important.
options.zh: 她覺得處理衝突令情緒疲憊，但重要。

options.en: The work was tiring only because of physical movement, with no emotional demand described.
options.zh: 工作只因身體活動而累，沒有情緒負荷。

options.en: The work must be meaningless because it made her tired.
options.zh: 工作令她累，所以必定沒意義。

scene.explanationZh: 情境已有情緒要求及疲憊，不是只體力活動；感到耗力也不等於工作沒意義。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論最不宜只憑 emotionally draining 得出？

options.en: The experience takes a lot of emotional energy.
options.zh: 經歷需大量情緒能量。

options.en: The person must be uncaring or morally weak.
options.zh: 當事人必定不關心或品格軟弱。

options.en: An experience can be valuable and exhausting at the same time.
options.zh: 經歷可同時有價值與令人疲憊。

contrast.explanationZh: 描述負荷不判品格。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說自己聽艱難經歷後累，你卻想寫她不在乎受訪者。哪句較準確？

options.en: Describe the emotional demand without treating tiredness as a lack of care.
options.zh: 描述情緒負荷，不把疲憊當缺乏關心。

options.en: Remove her expressed concern because exhaustion disproves it.
options.zh: 因疲憊推翻關心，就刪她表達的關切。

options.en: Use how energetic she looks as the only measure of whether she listened respectfully.
options.zh: 只按她看來多有精神衡量有沒有尊重聆聽。

dialogue.explanationZh: 負荷與關心可並存，不能用精神外觀代替行為。

speaking.en: It was emotionally draining, but I still valued the chance to understand their experience.
speaking.zh: 它讓我情緒上很疲憊，但我仍珍惜理解他們經歷的機會。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把情緒負荷與經歷價值分開。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫讀書反思，一本小說以很真切的筆觸描寫角色離別，你看後情緒疲憊，卻認為作品讓你理解其選擇。用一至兩句英文描述閱讀感受，不診斷任何人。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以真切離別及理解角色說明情緒負荷與價值並存，不從感到疲憊推成小說不好或角色有病。

examples.en: I found the novel emotionally draining because the farewell felt so vivid, but it helped me understand the character’s choice.
examples.zh: 我覺得小說令情緒疲憊，因離別寫得很真切，但它幫我理解角色選擇。

examples.en: The final chapter was emotionally draining rather than simply unenjoyable; I valued what it showed about the character’s loss.
examples.zh: 最後一章是情緒上很耗力，而非單純不好看；我重視它對角色失落的呈現。

takeaways.en: The conversation was emotionally draining, even though both friends valued being honest.
takeaways.zh: 談話令情緒疲憊，儘管兩位朋友都珍惜坦誠。

takeaways.en: She described the final chapter as emotionally draining because the character’s loss felt so immediate.
takeaways.zh: 她把最後一章形容為情緒上很耗力，因角色失落彷彿就在眼前。

titleZh: 沉浸在故事或活動之中

brief.meaningEn: Become deeply absorbed in an experience such as reading, as if gradually entering it.
brief.meaningZh: 深深投入閱讀等體驗，彷彿逐漸進入其中。
brief.grammar: sink into a novel/story; sank into in simple past, has sunk into in perfect; immersion sense specified by context.
brief.register: Contextual figurative absorption image using sink into; do not confuse with physical lowering or a worsening state.
brief.boundaryZh: 沉浸不表示小說真實發生、已記每個細節或外界事情永久消失；需看注意投入。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不同補語會帶不同意思，如 sink into a chair 是身體坐下，不能只按字面下沉解閱讀。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述持續投入及正確詞形，保留現實與故事區別。

listening.en: Once the interruptions stopped, I could sink into the novel, following the characters closely until the chapter ended.
listening.zh: 打斷停止後，我能沉浸小說，緊隨角色經歷，直到一章結束。
listening.promptZh: sink into 在此描述甚麼？

options.en: Becoming absorbed in following the story.
options.zh: 投入跟隨故事。

options.en: Continuing to glance away at each line instead of following the characters.
options.zh: 每行仍移開注意，而非跟隨角色。

options.en: Skimming only for the final outcome rather than attending to the chapter.
options.zh: 只略讀找最後結果，而非留意整章。

options.en: Postponing the reading even after the interruptions had stopped.
options.zh: 即使打斷已停，仍延後閱讀。

listening.explanationZh: following closely及until chapter ended指持續投入；不是繼續分心、只找結果或仍未開始讀。

reply.promptZh: 打斷停止後，你怎樣讀那本小說？
reply.promptEn: How did you read the novel once the interruptions stopped?

options.en: I followed the characters with sustained attention.
options.zh: 我持續專注跟隨角色。

options.en: I could sink into the novel instead of repeatedly looking away.
options.zh: 我能沉浸小說，而非反覆移開注意。

options.en: The chapter held my attention until its end.
options.zh: 那一章吸住注意直到完結。

options.en: I became absorbed in the story once I could read without interruptions.
options.zh: 能不受打斷地讀後，我投入故事。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述投入，不宣稱記得全部或真實發生。

scene.promptZh: 你用安靜時段讀一個長故事，留心人物對話，暫時不再頻繁看通知。哪句貼切？

options.en: I sank into the story and followed the dialogue closely.
options.zh: 我沉浸故事，仔細跟隨對話。

options.en: I ignored the story and checked each incoming alert instead.
options.zh: 我不理故事，改查每個新提示。

options.en: I skimmed for a brief summary without attending to the dialogue.
options.zh: 我略讀找短摘要，沒留意對話。

scene.explanationZh: 題目有留心對話及少看通知，支持投入；不合查每個提示或只找摘要。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像本課閱讀 sink into 的意思？

options.en: Becoming absorbed in a long story.
options.zh: 投入一個長故事。

options.en: Following the characters with sustained attention.
options.zh: 持續專注跟隨角色。

options.en: Looking away at every line and never engaging with the account.
options.zh: 每行都移開視線，從未投入敘述。

contrast.explanationZh: 不停分散且未投入，與沉浸相反。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友見你沉浸小說一章，就以為你已讀完整本；你其實仍有幾章未讀。哪句回應準確？

options.en: The chapter held my attention, but I still have several chapters to read.
options.zh: 那一章吸住我的注意，但我仍有幾章要讀。

options.en: Yes, I had reached the ending before that reading session began.
options.zh: 對，那次閱讀開始前，我已讀到結局。

options.en: I only looked up a plot summary instead of following the chapter.
options.zh: 我只查情節摘要，沒有跟隨那一章。

dialogue.explanationZh: 沉浸說注意投入，不決定整本完成；應保留這章有讀及後面仍未讀。

speaking.en: I sank into the story, but I still knew its events were fictional.
speaking.zh: 我沉浸故事，但仍知道其中事件是虛構。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清投入感與事件真實性。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你為角色配音，想先留一段安靜時間投入劇本對話，再錄兩個短版本比較語氣，還未選定最後演法。用一至兩句英文描述準備過程。
writing.selfCheckZh: 把投入劇本連到配音準備及試版本，保留最後演法尚需比較；不把一開始沉浸就說演法已定。

examples.en: I want time to sink into the script before trying two different ways of voicing the scene.
examples.zh: 我想先留時間沉浸劇本，再試兩種不同方法為場景配音。

examples.en: I sank into the dialogue first, then recorded two short tests to compare the tone before choosing the final performance.
examples.zh: 我先沉浸對話，再錄兩個短測試比較語氣，才選最後演法。

takeaways.en: She sank into the long story once the room became quiet.
takeaways.zh: 房間安靜後，她沉浸在長故事中。

takeaways.en: I wanted time to sink into the novel rather than read a line between each notification.
takeaways.zh: 我想留時間沉浸小說，而非每個通知之間只讀一行。

brief.meaningEn: Stop completely, whether movement or an activity; context shows whether it finishes or may resume.
brief.meaningZh: 移動或活動完全停下；是否結束或可再開始，需看情境。
brief.grammar: come to a full stop; came in past; has come in perfect. Full emphasises complete stopping.
brief.register: Established set phrase; this lesson extends the movement image to discussion or work.
brief.boundaryZh: 完全停不等於成功完成全部目標，也不必永久停止；與句末標點本身不同。
brief.misconceptionZh: 需分清停止、完成及解決問題，不能因不再進行就說所有事情已處理。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述活動完全停止，保留原因、結果與可否重啟。

sources.sentence: The discussion did not come to a full stop until everyone had spoken.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 14, table 1, row 6; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The discussion came to a full stop when the room closed, even though one question still needed a decision at the next meeting.
listening.zh: 房間關閉時，討論完全停下，即使仍有一個問題需下次會議決定。
listening.promptZh: 討論停止表示甚麼，未表示甚麼？

options.en: The activity stopped, but one decision remained for later.
options.zh: 活動停下，但一個決定留待之後。

options.en: Every question was resolved before the room closed.
options.zh: 房間關閉前每個問題都已解決。

options.en: The group had agreed never to discuss the issue again.
options.zh: 小組已議定永不再討論此事。

options.en: The discussion continued in the room without interruption.
options.zh: 討論在房間內不受打斷地繼續。

listening.explanationZh: even though 保留未決及next meeting，停止不是全解或永久結束。

reply.promptZh: 房間關閉時，討論怎樣了？
reply.promptEn: What happened to the discussion when the room closed?

options.en: It stopped, with one question left for the next meeting.
options.zh: 它停下，一個問題留待下次會議。

options.en: It came to a full stop before the final question was settled.
options.zh: 最後問題解決前，它完全停下。

options.en: We ended the session but still had a decision to make later.
options.zh: 我們結束環節，之後仍有決定需做。

options.en: The conversation ceased because we could no longer use the room.
options.zh: 因不能繼續用房，談話停止。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述停止與未決，金句不代表目標已完成。

scene.promptZh: 機器檢修時，刊物印製完全停止，之後修好會再開始；仍有半批未印。哪句準確？

options.en: Printing came to a full stop, although the order was not complete.
options.zh: 印製完全停下，但訂單未完成。

options.en: The stop confirms every copy had already been printed.
options.zh: 停下確認每份已印好。

options.en: The account says the publication will never be printed again.
options.zh: 敘述說刊物永不再印。

scene.explanationZh: 完全停與半批未完、稍後重啟可以並存。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜單靠 came to a full stop 得出？

options.en: The stated activity stopped completely at that point.
options.zh: 所說活動在那刻完全停下。

options.en: The work’s purpose was necessarily achieved successfully.
options.zh: 工作的目的必定已成功達成。

options.en: Further context can show whether the activity resumes.
options.zh: 更多情境可顯示活動是否再開始。

contrast.explanationZh: 停止不等於成功完成。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴因印製停下，就想把訂單記成已完成，但半批仍未印。哪句較準確？

options.en: Record the stop and the unfinished quantity separately.
options.zh: 分開記停止及未完成數量。

options.en: Use the stopped machine as confirmation of a finished order.
options.zh: 把停機當訂單完成的確認。

options.en: Mark the remaining copies as cancelled rather than waiting for the repaired machine.
options.zh: 把剩下份數記為取消，而非等修好機器。

dialogue.explanationZh: 停機、完成及取消不同；半批仍待印，不能當已完或取消。

speaking.en: The work came to a full stop, but that did not mean every task was finished.
speaking.zh: 工作完全停下，但不表示每項任務都完成。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清停止與完成。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫小說到角色需作決定的一幕，想不出合理回應，寫作完全停下；仍有兩幕未寫，你想先檢視角色動機再試。用一至兩句英文描述停滯及未完成部分。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以想不定角色回應說明寫作停滯，保留兩幕未寫及檢視動機的下一步，不把停下當完成。

examples.en: My writing came to a full stop because I could not settle the character’s response. I still have two scenes to draft.
examples.zh: 因想不定角色回應，我的寫作完全停下。我仍有兩幕要寫。

examples.en: The writing has come to a full stop at the decision scene, so I will review the character’s motives before trying again.
examples.zh: 寫作在決定一幕完全停下，所以再試之前，我會檢視角色動機。

takeaways.en: The conversation came to a full stop when the call ended, with one question left unanswered.
takeaways.zh: 通話結束時，談話完全停下，仍留一題未答。

takeaways.en: The work had come to a full stop, but the team planned to resume after the repair.
takeaways.zh: 工作已完全停下，但團隊計劃修好後再開始。

titleEn: ease my foot off the accelerator
titleZh: 像鬆開油門般逐漸減慢節奏

brief.meaningEn: Gradually reduce the pace or intensity of mental activity, using a driving image.
brief.meaningZh: 以駕駛意象，逐漸降低思考或活動節奏與強度。
brief.grammar: feel like easing my foot off the accelerator; ease/eased/easing; match possessive to speaker.
brief.register: Contextual driving metaphor, not literal driving instruction or a separate fixed whole idiom.
brief.boundaryZh: 減慢不等於完全停止、失去興趣或已解決問題；需指出哪種節奏減弱。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可有意從急速轉較平緩，不代表之前所有投入都錯，也不能假定每種平靜活動必定有相同作用。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述節奏變慢的感受，保留尚有活動及責任。

listening.en: Moving from rapid editing to a quiet review felt like easing my foot off the accelerator: I was still working, but no longer rushing between changes.
listening.zh: 從快速剪輯轉到安靜檢視，感覺像逐漸鬆開油門：我仍工作，但不再急着在改動之間轉。
listening.promptZh: 比喻描述哪種改變？

options.en: The work continued at a calmer pace.
options.zh: 工作以較平緩節奏繼續。

options.en: The editor finished the review and put the current project aside.
options.zh: 剪輯者已完成檢視，暫放當前項目。

options.en: The editor lost all interest and stopped looking at the draft.
options.zh: 剪輯者完全失去興趣，不再看草稿。

options.en: The sentence gives instructions for driving a car to the studio.
options.zh: 句子給開車去工作室的指示。

listening.explanationZh: still working及no longer rushing說仍做而減慢；不是已收工、失興趣或駕車指示。

reply.promptZh: 從快速剪輯轉到安靜檢視，感覺怎樣？
reply.promptEn: What did moving from rapid editing to quiet review feel like?

options.en: I was still engaged, but working less hurriedly.
options.zh: 我仍投入，但工作不那麼匆忙。

options.en: It felt like easing my foot off the accelerator while keeping the task in view.
options.zh: 感覺像鬆開油門，同時仍留意工作。

options.en: The pace became steadier without the work ending.
options.zh: 節奏較穩，而工作未結束。

options.en: I had space to review instead of jumping rapidly between changes.
options.zh: 我有空間檢視，而非快速在改動之間跳。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述降低節奏，金句不是駕車指示。

scene.promptZh: 你由急着完成很多短題，轉到慢慢檢查其中兩題，仍在學習但不再趕。哪句貼切？

options.en: It feels like easing my foot off the accelerator, not abandoning the work.
options.zh: 感覺像逐漸鬆開油門，而非放棄工作。

options.en: I stopped checking this section and put the questions aside.
options.zh: 我停止核對這部分，先放下題目。

options.en: I moved on to more new questions rather than reviewing the two existing ones.
options.zh: 我繼續做更多新題，不回顧已有兩題。

scene.explanationZh: 情境由趕做轉慢查兩題，仍有投入；不是放下或加做更多新題。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像本課減速比喻？

options.en: Continuing thoughtfully with less rushing.
options.zh: 較少匆忙，繼續細想地做。

options.en: Moving from rapid switching to a steadier review.
options.zh: 由快速切換轉穩定檢視。

options.en: Increasing the pace and taking on more tasks at once.
options.zh: 增加節奏並同時接更多工作。

contrast.explanationZh: 加快更多任務與減速方向相反。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴把你放慢核對的節奏寫成完全放棄，但你仍在細查兩個部分。哪句較準確？

options.en: Describe the slower review and the work that is still happening.
options.zh: 描述較慢檢視及仍在進行的工作。

options.en: Treat any reduction in pace as proof the task has been abandoned.
options.zh: 把任何減速當已放棄任務的證據。

options.en: Then I should say you are only checking one small part and have lost interest in the rest?
options.zh: 那我應說你只查一小部分，已對其餘失去興趣嗎？

dialogue.explanationZh: 已知仍細查兩部分；應描述速度與範圍，不把慢當放棄，也不加失興趣。

speaking.en: It feels like easing my foot off the accelerator, while I am still paying attention to the work.
speaking.zh: 感覺像逐漸鬆開油門，而我仍專注工作。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清節奏降低與放棄。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你參觀展覽時原本急着看完所有房間，後來決定只在兩件作品前慢慢觀察、寫幾個問題，仍有投入但不再追數量。用一至兩句英文描述節奏變化。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以停看兩件及提問描述較慢但仍投入，不把未看完每室當完全放棄，也不說慢一定適合所有參觀目標。

examples.en: Staying with two artworks feels like easing my foot off the accelerator after rushing through the rooms. I am noticing more rather than giving up on the visit.
examples.zh: 匆匆走過展室後，在兩件作品前停留感覺像鬆開油門。我留意更多，而非放棄參觀。

examples.en: I want to ease my foot off the accelerator by observing a smaller selection carefully, instead of treating the visit as a race to finish every room.
examples.zh: 我想仔細看較少作品，像鬆開油門般放慢，而非把參觀當跑遍每間房的比賽。

takeaways.en: Reading one paragraph carefully felt like easing my foot off the accelerator after a hurried day.
takeaways.zh: 匆忙一天後，細讀一段感覺像逐漸鬆開油門。

takeaways.en: I eased my foot off the accelerator in the discussion, giving each idea more time before moving on.
takeaways.zh: 我在討論中像鬆開油門般放慢，給每個構思更多時間才繼續。

brief.meaningEn: Substantially alter how a situation works or what people can do within it.
brief.meaningZh: 大幅改變事情的運作方式，或人們在其中能做甚麼。
brief.grammar: a development changes the game for a group; changed in past; describe the before-and-after conditions.
brief.register: Established sporting metaphor used beyond sport. The noun a game changer expresses a related idea through a different grammatical frame.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是任何小改動都適合，也不保證所有人受惠或原有方法立即消失；需具體重要改變。
brief.misconceptionZh: 受歡迎或換外觀不必然代表運作局面已大改。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以具體前後差異支持重大改變，保留影響範圍。

listening.en: The shared booking system changed the game for the rehearsal groups: they could see available rooms and reserve them directly, instead of waiting for someone to answer each request.
listening.zh: 共用預約系統大幅改變排練小組的安排方式：他們可直接看空房並預約，不再等人逐一回覆。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼支持 changed the game？

options.en: The groups gained a direct way to check and book rooms.
options.zh: 小組有了直接查房及預約的方法。

options.en: The system changed its colour while the same manual replies remained necessary.
options.zh: 系統換顏色，但仍需同樣人手回覆。

options.en: The groups lost their ability to see available rooms.
options.zh: 小組失去查看空房的能力。

options.en: Room booking continued through the old request process alone.
options.zh: 預約只繼續經舊有請求程序。

listening.explanationZh: 可見空房並直接預約，改變原先等待的運作方式，不只是外觀。

reply.promptZh: 共用系統為甚麼對排練小組影響大？
reply.promptEn: Why did the shared system make such a big difference to the rehearsal groups?

options.en: They could book an available room themselves rather than wait for individual replies.
options.zh: 他們可自行預約空房，不用等逐一回覆。

options.en: It changed the game by making availability visible and booking direct.
options.zh: 它讓空房可見、預約直接，大幅改變局面。

options.en: The new process removed the wait for someone to handle each request.
options.zh: 新程序除去等人處理每項請求的時間。

options.en: Checking and reserving a room became something the groups could do directly.
options.zh: 查房及留房變成小組可直接做的事。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給已交代的重要運作差異，不只說系統好。

scene.promptZh: 原本只有現場觀眾可提問，新安排讓遠處參加者也能即時發問並獲主持回應。哪句最能描述參與方式的大改變？

options.en: The live question channel changed the game for people attending remotely.
options.zh: 即時提問渠道大幅改變遠處參加者的參與方式。

options.en: The new channel only changed the title of the event, leaving participation as before.
options.zh: 新渠道只改活動名稱，參與仍如前。

options.en: The change meant remote participants could watch but still had no way to ask questions.
options.zh: 改變表示遠處參加者可看，但仍無法提問。

scene.explanationZh: 原先不能提問，現在可即時互動，是重要條件改變。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 changed the game 的強度？

options.en: A previously excluded group gains a practical way to participate.
options.zh: 原被排除的小組有了實際參與方法。

options.en: Only the button colour changes; access, timing and the process remain the same.
options.zh: 只有按鈕顏色改變，使用機會、時間及程序不變。

options.en: A new method removes a major constraint on how the work can be done.
options.zh: 新方法除去工作方式的一項重大限制。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有重要運作差異時，這個強表達缺乏支持。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴因新預約系統很受歡迎，就想說每個使用者都受惠、舊方法已完全消失；你只知可直接預約。哪句較準確？

options.en: Explain the direct booking change, then check who can use it before making wider claims.
options.zh: 先說直接預約的改變，再查誰能使用，才作更廣說法。

options.en: Treat the favourable comments as proof that every user has equal access.
options.zh: 把好評當每位使用者都有同等使用機會的證據。

options.en: Leave out the direct booking feature and judge the impact only by the new screen design.
options.zh: 刪直接預約功能，只憑新畫面設計判斷影響。

dialogue.explanationZh: 重要功能支持局面改變，但普及程度及其他方法狀態仍需資料。

speaking.en: The new process changed the game for our group, though its wider effects still needed checking.
speaking.zh: 新程序大幅改變我們小組的局面，但更廣影響仍需核對。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再用具體範圍描述重要改變。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社團選創作方案，原先先看作者姓名及職銜；現在先匿名讀方案內容，最後才揭示作者，讓不熟悉的人也有機會按作品獲考慮。用一至兩句英文說明評選方式的重大改變，不宣稱已消除所有偏見。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以先看作品、後揭姓名職銜說明機制變化，保留仍需檢視評選，不把匿名直接等同完全公平。

examples.en: Reading the proposals anonymously changed the game for less familiar contributors: their work was considered before their names were revealed. We still need to review how the choices are made.
examples.zh: 匿名讀方案，大幅改變不熟悉的投稿者所面對的局面：作品先獲考慮，之後才揭示名字。我們仍需檢視選擇方式。

examples.en: The anonymous first round changed the game by putting the proposals ahead of job titles. It did not remove the need for careful judging.
examples.zh: 首輪匿名讓方案先於職銜，大幅改變局面。這沒有除去審慎評選的需要。

takeaways.en: The direct route changed the game for residents who had previously needed two transfers.
takeaways.zh: 直接路線大幅改變原先需轉兩次車的居民所面對的情況。

takeaways.en: Shared access to the records changed the game for the team’s research.
takeaways.zh: 共用紀錄的安排大幅改變團隊研究的局面。

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese translations checked against each English sentence; not independent human approval.

notes: Root curation retains noun a game changer as a useful distinct count-noun/article frame; not a claim of a different core concept.

brief.meaningEn: Go from place to place or change location, often repeatedly.
brief.meaningZh: 由一處走到另一處，或經常轉換地點。
brief.grammar: someone moves around; moved around in past; this lesson uses the intransitive person/location pattern, not move objects around.
brief.register: Common movement pattern, often literal. It does not by itself mean moving house or having no fixed home.
brief.boundaryZh: 地點範圍可大可小；要看情境，不單憑片語推成移居或四處遊蕩。
brief.misconceptionZh: 走動多不表示工作沒做完，也不決定要用哪種設備。
brief.outcomeZh: 能交代誰在何處走動，保留移動與完成工作之別。

listening.en: During the exhibition check, I moved around between the entrance, the display tables and the noticeboard, recording what needed attention at each point.
listening.zh: 檢查展覽時，我在入口、展示桌及告示板之間走動，記下各處需注意的事。
listening.promptZh: moved around 在此指甚麼？

options.en: The speaker went between several points within the exhibition.
options.zh: 說話者在展覽內幾個位置之間走動。

options.en: The speaker moved home to a different town.
options.zh: 說話者搬家到另一個鎮。

options.en: The display tables were rearranged while the speaker stayed in one place.
options.zh: 說話者留在原處，展示桌被重新排列。

options.en: The check was carried out entirely from the entrance without going elsewhere.
options.zh: 檢查全程只在入口進行，沒有去別處。

listening.explanationZh: between 列明場內位置，是人物走動，不是搬家或搬桌。

reply.promptZh: 檢查展覽期間，你去了哪些地方？
reply.promptEn: Where did you go during the exhibition check?

options.en: I went between the entrance, the tables and the noticeboard.
options.zh: 我走到入口、桌子及告示板各處。

options.en: I moved around the exhibition to check the different points.
options.zh: 我在展覽內走動，檢查不同位置。

options.en: I visited several parts of the display rather than staying at the entrance.
options.zh: 我去了展示的幾個部分，不只留在入口。

options.en: My check took me from one point in the exhibition to another.
options.zh: 檢查讓我從展覽內一處走到另一處。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述人物在場內移動，不加搬家或重排桌子。

scene.promptZh: 你在社區花園觀察植物，先看靠門的花圃，再到樹旁及水桶邊作筆記，沒有搬植物。哪句準確？

options.en: I moved around the garden to record observations at different spots.
options.zh: 我在花園內走動，記錄不同位置的觀察。

options.en: I moved the plants around while staying beside the gate.
options.zh: 我留在門旁，把植物搬來搬去。

options.en: I remained at the first bed throughout the observation.
options.zh: 整個觀察期間，我一直留在首個花圃。

scene.explanationZh: 移動的是觀察者，不是植物；也不一直留首處。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜單憑 she moves around often 得出？

options.en: She frequently changes location within the relevant setting.
options.zh: 她在相關環境經常轉換位置。

options.en: She must be relocating her home each time.
options.zh: 她每次必定在搬家。

options.en: More context is needed to know how far she travels.
options.zh: 需更多情境才知她移動多遠。

contrast.explanationZh: 走動可在同一場所內，不等於搬家。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴把你在展場走動的紀錄寫成搬了展示桌，但桌子沒移位。哪句修訂準確？

options.en: Say that I moved around to inspect the points, while the tables stayed where they were.
options.zh: 寫我走動檢查各處，而桌子留在原位。

options.en: So I should say the tables were moved closer to the entrance?
options.zh: 所以我應寫桌子被搬近入口嗎？

options.en: Describe the whole check as stationary because the furniture did not move.
options.zh: 因家具沒移動，就把整個檢查寫成原地進行。

dialogue.explanationZh: 移動的是檢查者，桌子仍在原位；不能寫家具移近入口，也不因家具沒動就當人原地檢查。

speaking.en: I moved around the room to check several points, without moving the furniture.
speaking.zh: 我在房內走動檢查幾個位置，沒有搬家具。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清人物走動及搬物件。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你編一個尋線索遊戲，參加者需先看門口符號，再到地圖旁核對，最後到窗邊找下一張提示；你想在說明中交代要在房內走動，並提示保持通道暢通。用一至兩句英文寫玩法。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明參加者依次轉換位置與留通道，不把走動寫成搬符號或搬家。

examples.en: Players will move around the room, checking the door symbol, the map and then the clue by the window. Please keep the route clear for others.
examples.zh: 參加者會在房內走動，依次查看門口符號、地圖及窗旁提示。請為其他人保持路線暢通。

examples.en: Move around to follow the clues in order, rather than gathering at the first symbol. Leave space for the next player to pass.
examples.zh: 依次走動跟隨線索，不要聚在首個符號前。留空間讓下一位通過。

takeaways.en: She moved around the workshop to see how each group was getting on.
takeaways.zh: 她在工作坊內走動，看看各組進展。

takeaways.en: We move around during the survey instead of observing everything from one desk.
takeaways.zh: 調查期間我們會走動，不只從一張桌旁觀察一切。

titleZh: 即時取得或使用的機會

brief.meaningEn: The ability to reach, obtain or use something immediately.
brief.meaningZh: 能立即找到、取得或使用某物。
brief.grammar: instant access to + resource; give/provide someone with instant access; access is normally uncountable here.
brief.register: Natural noun collocation describing immediacy, often for information or a service.
brief.boundaryZh: 即時取得不等於免費、毋須權限、全部內容完整或資訊必定正確；要查具體條件。
brief.misconceptionZh: 能打開資料與已理解或核實資料不同。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說清可即時使用甚麼，保留權限、內容及核實條件。

sources.sentence: The app gives readers instant access to the catalogue.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 14, table 2, row 4; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: Once their membership was confirmed, the researchers had instant access to the scanned letters, although they still needed to compare the dates with the catalogue notes.
listening.zh: 會員資格確認後，研究者能即時查看信件掃描，但仍需與目錄筆記比較日期。
listening.promptZh: 已能即時做甚麼，仍需做甚麼？

options.en: View the scans immediately, then check their dates against the notes.
options.zh: 立即看掃描，再按筆記核對日期。

options.en: Treat every date as verified merely because the scans opened.
options.zh: 只因掃描能開啟，就把每個日期當已核實。

options.en: View the letters only after waiting for a separate paper delivery.
options.zh: 只有等另送紙本後才能看信。

options.en: Use the scans before membership was confirmed, according to the account.
options.zh: 按敘述，資格確認前就可用掃描。

listening.explanationZh: once confirmed 是條件，instant 是速度，核日期仍未完成。

reply.promptZh: 會員資格確認後，你們取得了甚麼便利？
reply.promptEn: What became easier once your membership was confirmed?

options.en: We could view the scanned letters straight away.
options.zh: 我們可立即看信件掃描。

options.en: We had instant access to the scans once membership was confirmed.
options.zh: 會員資格確認後，我們能即時查看掃描。

options.en: There was no extra wait to open the letters after confirmation.
options.zh: 確認後，開信件不需額外等待。

options.en: The scans became immediately available to us under the confirmed membership.
options.zh: 在已確認會員資格下，掃描立即可供我們使用。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述即時使用，不把速度變成內容已核實。

scene.promptZh: 登入獲授權帳戶後，你可立即看社團排練表，但表上的待確認時段仍要問負責人。哪句準確？

options.en: The account gives me instant access to the timetable, not automatic confirmation of every slot.
options.zh: 帳戶讓我即時看時間表，不會自動確認每個時段。

options.en: Opening the timetable means all provisional slots have been approved.
options.zh: 能開時間表，就表示所有暫定時段已批准。

options.en: The account lets me see the timetable only after a later paper copy arrives.
options.zh: 帳戶只讓我在稍後紙本抵達後看時間表。

scene.explanationZh: 立即可看與待確認欄位是兩件事。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 instant access 得出？

options.en: The resource can be reached immediately under the stated conditions.
options.zh: 在所述條件下，可立即取得資源。

options.en: The resource is necessarily free and every detail has been verified.
options.zh: 資源必定免費，而且每項細節已核實。

options.en: The context must identify what access is being offered.
options.zh: 情境需指出提供的是哪種使用機會。

contrast.explanationZh: 即時只說速度，未說收費及資料真假。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴把信件可即時開啟寫成日期已全部核對，但研究者仍需比較筆記。哪句較準確？

options.en: Report immediate access separately from the date checks that remain to be done.
options.zh: 分開報告即時查看及仍待做的日期核對。

options.en: Mark the dates verified because the files became available without a wait.
options.zh: 因檔案不用等就可用，便把日期記成已核實。

options.en: Say the letters are unavailable until every comparison is complete.
options.zh: 直到每項比較完成前，都說信件不可用。

dialogue.explanationZh: 能取用與核實完成不同，兩者不能互相代替。

speaking.en: We have instant access to the records, but we still need to check the relevant details.
speaking.zh: 我們能即時查看紀錄，但仍需核對相關細節。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清使用便利及核實。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替戲劇小組寫演出安排，已獲授權的演員掃碼就可立即開最新提示單；仍需按自己角色讀當晚改動，不可只開了檔案就說已看懂。用一至兩句英文說明便利及責任。
writing.selfCheckZh: 交代誰可即時開哪份單，保留閱讀自身角色改動的責任，不把開啟等同理解或擅改權限。

examples.en: The code gives authorised cast members instant access to the latest cue sheet. Each performer still needs to read the changes for their own role.
examples.zh: 代碼讓獲授權演員即時查看最新提示單。每位演員仍需讀自己角色的改動。

examples.en: We have instant access to the updated sheet, but opening it is only the start. Please check the cues that affect your part tonight.
examples.zh: 我們能即時查看更新提示單，但開啟只是開始。請核對今晚影響自己角色的提示。

takeaways.en: The portal gave the team instant access to the revised room plan.
takeaways.zh: 平台讓團隊即時查看修訂房間圖。

takeaways.en: Instant access to the guide helped us find the right section before the meeting.
takeaways.zh: 能即時查看指南，幫我們在會議前找到所需部分。

titleEn: a larger slice of the pie

brief.meaningEn: A greater share of the available money, market, resources or benefits.
brief.meaningZh: 在可分配金錢、市場、資源或利益中，佔較大份額。
brief.grammar: get/have/receive a larger slice of the pie; larger compares shares, so identify the resource and comparison.
brief.register: Established food-share idiom, especially American; cake is common in British variants. British pronunciation does not require changing the supplied pie wording.
brief.boundaryZh: 份額增大不必然代表實際數量增大，因總量也可能改變；也不自行判斷分配是否公平。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要分清所佔比例與整體大小，不把一方份額較大直接當人人得更多。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說清資源及比較，分開份額、總量與公平判斷。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.expression: a larger slice of the pie
sources.sentence: Online shops now have a larger slice of the pie.

listening.en: Under the revised allocation, equipment repair received a larger slice of the pie: its share rose from a fifth to a quarter of the same maintenance budget.
listening.zh: 修訂分配後，設備維修佔更大份額：在同一筆保養預算中，比例由五分之一升至四分之一。
listening.promptZh: 這裏的 pie 是甚麼？

options.en: The maintenance budget being divided among uses.
options.zh: 分配給各用途的保養預算。

options.en: The number of repair requests, regardless of the budget allocation.
options.zh: 維修請求數目，與預算分配無關。

options.en: A rise in the whole budget rather than a change in the repair share.
options.zh: 整體預算上升，而非維修份額改變。

options.en: A reduction in repair’s proportion from a quarter to a fifth.
options.zh: 維修比例由四分之一減至五分之一。

listening.explanationZh: 同一預算、五分一至四分一，說明維修所佔份額增大。

reply.promptZh: 維修在修訂預算中的份額怎樣變了？
reply.promptEn: How did repair’s share change in the revised budget?

options.en: Its proportion increased from a fifth to a quarter.
options.zh: 它的比例由五分之一增至四分之一。

options.en: It received a larger slice of the pie within the same total budget.
options.zh: 在同一總預算內，它取得更大份額。

options.en: More of the existing maintenance budget was allocated to repair.
options.zh: 原有保養預算有更多分給維修。

options.en: Repair’s share grew while the overall budget stayed the same.
options.zh: 整體預算不變，維修份額增大。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都交代同一資源的份額改變，不混成總預算增大。

scene.promptZh: 展場可用時段總數不變，新方案把更多時段分給學生作品，其他用途相應減少。哪句準確？

options.en: Student work now gets a larger slice of the pie in the exhibition schedule.
options.zh: 學生作品現在在展覽時間表中佔較大份額。

options.en: Every use has gained extra time because the total number of slots increased.
options.zh: 因時段總數增加，每個用途都獲額外時間。

options.en: Student work keeps the same share while only the labels change.
options.zh: 學生作品份額不變，只改標籤。

scene.explanationZh: 總數不變而學生份額增加，不能說人人多了額外時間。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 a larger slice of the pie 得出？

options.en: The share is greater relative to the relevant comparison.
options.zh: 相對相關比較，份額較大。

options.en: The total resource must also have become larger.
options.zh: 資源總量必定也增大。

options.en: We need context to know which resource is divided.
options.zh: 需情境才知分配哪種資源。

contrast.explanationZh: 較大份額與較大總量不同。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說維修份額增加，就表示維修請求必定變多，但你只知預算分配。哪句較準確？

options.en: Report the increased allocation, and check the request figures before explaining why it changed.
options.zh: 報告分配增加，解釋原因前先查請求數字。

options.en: Use the budget proportion as the count of repair requests.
options.zh: 把預算比例當維修請求數目。

options.en: Keep the former fifth as the current figure because the total budget did not grow.
options.zh: 因總預算沒增，就仍用原來五分之一作現況。

dialogue.explanationZh: 份額變化不是請求數目的證據，總量不變亦不代表比例不變。

speaking.en: Repair received a larger slice of the pie, although the total budget stayed the same.
speaking.zh: 維修取得更大份額，儘管總預算不變。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清份額與總量。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：園藝小組分配同一幅種植地，原先香草佔兩成，試種後決定下季佔三成，其他作物仍保留部分。用一至兩句英文描述土地分配改變，不把份額說成土地總面積增加。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明香草在同一土地中由兩成增至三成，保留其他作物，不把重新分配寫成增地。

examples.en: Herbs will get a larger slice of the pie next season, rising from twenty to thirty per cent of the same growing area. Other crops will still have space.
examples.zh: 下季香草將佔更大份額，在同一種植面積中由兩成升至三成。其他作物仍有空間。

examples.en: We are giving herbs a larger slice of the pie by reallocating the existing beds, not by enlarging the garden.
examples.zh: 我們重新分配原有花圃，讓香草佔更大份額，並非擴大花園。

takeaways.en: The youth programme gained a larger slice of the pie in the revised use of hall time.
takeaways.zh: 青年活動在修訂場地時間分配中取得更大份額。

takeaways.en: Local projects received a larger slice of the pie, even though the fund itself did not grow.
takeaways.zh: 地方項目獲較大份額，儘管基金本身沒有增加。

titleEn: as far as practicality is concerned

brief.meaningEn: Limit the following judgement to practical usefulness or feasibility.
brief.meaningZh: 把接着的判斷限於實際使用或可行性方面。
brief.grammar: As far as practicality is concerned, + judgement; singular practicality takes is, not are.
brief.register: Natural framing pattern, somewhat deliberate or formal. Other aspects may lead to different judgements.
brief.boundaryZh: 實用性較好不等於外觀、情感價值、價格等方面都最好；需交代相關使用需要。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把限定一個方面的句子，改寫成全面排名或普遍保證。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體需要作有限度比較，並保留其他考量。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.expression: as far as practicality is concerned
sources.sentence: As far as practicality is concerned, the smaller bag is better.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 15, table 1, row 3; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: As far as practicality is concerned, the folding display suits our travelling workshop because it fits in the van and can be set up by two people; we have not compared the visual designs yet.
listening.zh: 就實用性而言，摺疊展示架適合巡迴工作坊，因能放入客貨車、兩人可架設；我們尚未比較外觀設計。
listening.promptZh: 說話者作了哪個範圍的判斷？

options.en: Suitability for transport and setup, without judging the appearance yet.
options.zh: 搬運及架設是否合適，尚未判斷外觀。

options.en: An overall judgement that it is the best design in every respect.
options.zh: 它在所有方面都是最佳設計的全面判斷。

options.en: A judgement based only on colour, with no practical reasons given.
options.zh: 只按顏色的判斷，沒有實際理由。

options.en: A claim that two people had already compared all the visual designs.
options.zh: 聲稱兩人已比較所有外觀設計。

listening.explanationZh: fits van及two people setup 是實用理由，未比外觀限制判斷範圍。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼摺疊展示架適合這次巡迴工作坊？
reply.promptEn: Why does the folding display suit this travelling workshop?

options.en: It fits in our van and only needs two people to set up.
options.zh: 它能放進我們的車，兩人就能架設。

options.en: As far as practicality is concerned, its size and setup needs suit our team.
options.zh: 就實用性而言，它的大小及架設需要適合團隊。

options.en: Our transport and staffing arrangements can accommodate it.
options.zh: 我們的運輸及人手安排能配合它。

options.en: The team can carry it to each venue and assemble it with the available people.
options.zh: 團隊能帶它到各場地，並以現有人手組裝。

reply.explanationZh: 四句給運輸及架設理由，不替未比較的外觀下結論。

scene.promptZh: 你們比較活動用桌，摺桌能經窄門且可收起，另一張外觀更美；你只想先評使用安排。哪句準確？

options.en: As far as practicality is concerned, the folding table better suits the doorway and storage space.
options.zh: 就實用性而言，摺桌較合門口及儲存空間。

options.en: The folding table is more attractive, although we have only checked its size.
options.zh: 雖然只查大小，摺桌仍是外觀更美。

options.en: The more attractive table is also the easier one to store, although its storage dimensions have not been checked.
options.zh: 較美的桌也較易收存，雖然它的儲存尺寸未核對。

scene.explanationZh: 已查的窄門及收存支持摺桌的實用性；不能把尺寸優點當外觀較美的依據，亦不能未量另一桌就報更易收存。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 as far as practicality is concerned 的限定得出？

options.en: The speaker is considering practical use.
options.zh: 說話者正考慮實際使用。

options.en: Every other criterion has already been settled in its favour.
options.zh: 其他每個準則都已判它較好。

options.en: Aesthetic or emotional considerations may still matter separately.
options.zh: 美感或情感考量仍可能另有重要性。

contrast.explanationZh: 限定一面不表示其他準則已全定。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把展示架適合運輸，直接寫成觀眾必定最喜歡的外觀；外觀尚未比較。哪句較準確？

options.en: Keep the transport advantage, then assess the visual effect separately.
options.zh: 保留運輸優點，再另行評估視覺效果。

options.en: Use the easy setup as the audience’s stated preference for its appearance.
options.zh: 把容易架設當觀眾已說的外觀偏好。

options.en: Drop the transport evidence because appearance has not yet been assessed.
options.zh: 因外觀尚未評估，就刪運輸依據。

dialogue.explanationZh: 已知實用證據可保留，不能冒充未有的外觀判斷。

speaking.en: As far as practicality is concerned, this option suits us, though we still need to compare the designs.
speaking.zh: 就實用性而言，這選項適合我們，但仍需比較設計。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把判斷限於已查方面。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你與朋友選家用食譜，某本用你們已有廚具、步驟配合平日晚餐時間；另一本照片很吸引但未試。你想先說實用選擇，仍留時間欣賞另一本，不作全面優劣排名。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以已有廚具及平日晚餐時間支持實用選擇，將照片美感留作另一考量，不把一句限定判斷變全面排名。

examples.en: As far as practicality is concerned, this cookbook suits our weekday meals because it uses the equipment we already have. We can enjoy the other book’s photographs separately.
examples.zh: 就實用性而言，這本食譜用我們已有廚具，適合平日晚餐。我們可另行欣賞另一本的照片。

examples.en: As far as practicality is concerned, I would start with the recipes that fit our evening schedule, without judging which book is more beautiful.
examples.zh: 就實用性而言，我會先從配合晚間時間表的食譜開始，不判哪本較美。

takeaways.en: As far as practicality is concerned, the shorter rehearsal fits the time we have in the room.
takeaways.zh: 就實用性而言，較短排練配合我們可用房間的時間。

takeaways.en: As far as practicality is concerned, this format is easier for our team to update.
takeaways.zh: 就實用性而言，團隊較容易更新這種格式。

titleZh: 在挑戰下維持原有地位

brief.meaningEn: Maintain a position despite pressure or competition, rather than give way.
brief.meaningZh: 面對壓力或競爭仍維持地位，而非退讓。
brief.grammar: hold one’s ground; held in past; match possessive to subject. Here ground is a position or role, not physical soil.
brief.register: Established defensive idiom. Can describe a sustained view or competitive position; the present examples focus on a continuing role under pressure.
brief.boundaryZh: 守住地位不等於完全壓倒對方、毫無變化或永遠不會退讓；要交代比較範圍與依據。
brief.misconceptionZh: 仍有重要位置，與已取得最大份額不同。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述挑戰下維持的作用，保留程度及時間範圍。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Printed books still hold their ground in schools.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 15, table 1, row 4; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Printed books still hold their ground in schools.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 99, table 1, row 7; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: Handwritten planning notes held their ground in our team despite the new app: several members still used them to sketch connections before adding the final tasks online.
listening.zh: 儘管有新應用程式，手寫規劃筆記在團隊中仍保地位：幾位成員仍用它畫關聯，再把最後任務加到網上。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼支持 held their ground？

options.en: Handwritten notes kept a useful role alongside the app.
options.zh: 手寫筆記與應用程式並用，仍有實用作用。

options.en: Every team member abandoned the app and used paper alone.
options.zh: 每位組員都棄應用程式，只用紙。

options.en: Paper notes had disappeared from the planning process.
options.zh: 紙筆記已從規劃程序消失。

options.en: The app was introduced only after all planning had ended.
options.zh: 所有規劃結束後，才引入應用程式。

listening.explanationZh: 仍用手寫畫關聯，再加任務上網，支持並用中的持續地位。

reply.promptZh: 有新應用程式後，手寫筆記在團隊中怎樣？
reply.promptEn: What happened to handwritten notes after the team got the new app?

options.en: Several members still used paper to sketch connections first.
options.zh: 幾位成員仍先用紙畫關聯。

options.en: They held their ground as a useful part of planning alongside the app.
options.zh: 它們與應用程式並用，仍在規劃中保有實用地位。

options.en: Paper continued to serve a purpose before final tasks went online.
options.zh: 最後任務上網前，紙筆記仍有作用。

options.en: The new tool did not remove the team’s use of handwritten sketches.
options.zh: 新工具沒有除去團隊使用手繪草圖的做法。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給持續用途，不把保地位說成全面勝過新工具。

scene.promptZh: 雖然有大型連鎖店，街角修補店仍靠熟悉客人物件、提供細緻修理而維持固定客源。哪句準確？

options.en: The repair shop has held its ground despite the larger competitors.
options.zh: 修補店面對較大競爭者仍守住地位。

options.en: The shop has overtaken the chains and now serves the largest share of local customers.
options.zh: 小店已超越連鎖店，現服務本地最大比例顧客。

options.en: The shop has stopped serving regular customers since the chains arrived.
options.zh: 連鎖店出現後，小店已停止服務熟客。

scene.explanationZh: 維持固定客源支持守住地位，未說市場份額最大，也不是停止服務。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜單憑 held their ground 得出？

options.en: They maintained a position despite pressure.
options.zh: 他們在壓力下維持地位。

options.en: They have overtaken their rivals rather than simply maintained their position.
options.zh: 他們已超越對手，不只是維持地位。

options.en: The context should show what position was maintained.
options.zh: 情境應顯示維持的是哪種地位。

contrast.explanationZh: 守住是維持；超越對手成領先是另需證據的變化。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴把幾位成員仍用手寫筆記，寫成團隊完全棄用應用程式；最後任務其實仍上網。哪句較準確？

options.en: Describe the continuing paper role alongside the app rather than replacing coexistence with total rejection.
options.zh: 描述紙筆記與程式並用的持續作用，不把並用改成全拒。

options.en: So the team now completes the whole planning process on paper instead of putting tasks online?
options.zh: 所以團隊現用紙完成整個規劃，不再把任務上網嗎？

options.en: Treat the app’s introduction as proof that no handwritten planning can remain.
options.zh: 把引入程式當手寫規劃不可能保留的證據。

dialogue.explanationZh: 手寫先畫關聯，最後任務仍上網；兩種方法並用，不是整個流程回紙，也不是紙筆記全消失。

speaking.en: The small team held its ground, but that did not mean every competitor had disappeared.
speaking.zh: 小團隊守住地位，但不表示每個競爭者都消失。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清維持地位與全面取代。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：討論活動安排時，多數人想延長問答，你代表接待組解釋必須保留收拾時間，最後方案仍保留這段時間。用一至兩句英文說明你在壓力下堅持的立場及具體理由，不把其他人寫成敵人。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以收尾需要說明維持立場，保留最後方案及可協調範圍，不把堅持說成羞辱或完全拒絕他人。

examples.en: I held my ground on keeping time for the closing tasks, explaining that the reception team needed it to pack the materials. The final schedule kept that interval.
examples.zh: 我堅持保留收尾時間，解釋接待組需用它收拾材料。最後時間表保留該時段。

examples.en: We held our ground during the discussion because the room had to be cleared before the next group arrived. We could still support a longer question session within that limit.
examples.zh: 我們在討論中堅持立場，因下一組到前必須清好房間。在這限制內，我們仍可支持較長問答。

takeaways.en: The local service held its ground by continuing to meet needs the larger provider had overlooked.
takeaways.zh: 本地服務繼續回應大機構忽略的需要，守住地位。

takeaways.en: She held her ground on the agreed review time while listening to the other proposals.

titleZh: 如消散般逐漸不復存在

brief.meaningEn: Become less present until disappearing, using an image of fading away into empty space.
brief.meaningZh: 以淡化至消散的意象，描述逐漸不再存在。
brief.grammar: a custom fades/faded into thin air; can appear under negation, as in did not fade into thin air overnight.
brief.register: Contextual combination of gradual fade and the thin-air disappearance image. It should not be presented as a fixed expression requiring sudden disappearance.
brief.boundaryZh: fade 常有漸減意味；overnight 可被否定，不能忽略 not 就報作一夜消失。也不能單憑意象確定原因。
brief.misconceptionZh: 完全不見的結果與變化速度不同；要按時間及否定詞理解。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述逐漸消散或否定突然消失，保留具體時間與因果依據。

sources.sentence: The old custom did not fade into thin air overnight.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 15, table 1, row 7; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The shared storytelling custom did not fade into thin air overnight: older residents kept it going for years, although fewer families joined each winter.
listening.zh: 共同講故事的習俗並非一夜消散：長者多年維持它，儘管每冬參與家庭越來越少。
listening.promptZh: 說話者怎樣描述變化？

options.en: Participation declined over years, rather than the custom disappearing in one night.
options.zh: 參與多年漸減，而非習俗一夜消失。

options.en: The custom disappeared completely on the first winter evening.
options.zh: 習俗在首個冬夜完全消失。

options.en: Every winter brought more participating families than before.
options.zh: 每冬參與家庭都比以前多。

options.en: The account gives a confirmed single cause for the decline.
options.zh: 敘述給出已確認的單一衰退原因。

listening.explanationZh: not overnight及kept going for years 保留延續，fewer 說減少而非增長；未給單一原因。

reply.promptZh: 那個講故事習俗是否突然就消失了？
reply.promptEn: Did the storytelling custom simply disappear all at once?

options.en: No; residents continued it for years as participation gradually declined.
options.zh: 不是；參與漸減時，居民仍延續多年。

options.en: It did not fade into thin air overnight; older residents kept it going.
options.zh: 它並非一夜消散；長者仍維持它。

options.en: The change took place over years rather than in a single night.
options.zh: 變化經歷多年，而非一夜。

options.en: There was a continuing tradition, though fewer families came each winter.
options.zh: 傳統仍延續，儘管每冬來的家庭較少。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都保留否定突然消失及實際延續，不忽略 not。

scene.promptZh: 你回顧一份兒時校刊，內容仍影響舊同學多年後的交談，想否定「畢業一到影響就消失」。哪句貼切？

options.en: Its influence did not fade into thin air when we left school.
options.zh: 離校時，它的影響並沒有就此消散。

options.en: Graduation immediately removed every trace of its influence.
options.zh: 畢業立即除去它的每一點影響。

options.en: The later conversations show that nobody remembered the magazine.
options.zh: 後來交談顯示沒人記得校刊。

scene.explanationZh: 多年後仍談內容支持影響延續，不是畢業即消失。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項對 did not fade into thin air overnight 的理解不正確？

options.en: The sentence rejects disappearance within a single night.
options.zh: 句子否定在一夜內消失。

options.en: The sentence confirms an immediate and complete disappearance.
options.zh: 句子確認立即完全消失。

options.en: Further context may describe a slower change or continuing presence.
options.zh: 更多情境可描述較慢變化或仍存在。

contrast.explanationZh: not 否定突然消失，不能讀成確認已消失。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴只看 overnight，就把多年漸減的習俗寫成某晚突然消失；原句有 did not。哪句修訂較準確？

options.en: Keep the negation and explain the years of continued practice alongside the decline.
options.zh: 保留否定，說明參與減少時仍延續多年的做法。

options.en: Remove the years of continued practice because overnight must describe an actual single-night event.
options.zh: 因 overnight 必定描述真實一夜事件，就刪延續多年。

options.en: Replace the falling participation with complete stability, since the custom did not vanish at once.
options.zh: 因習俗非立即消失，就把參與下降改成完全穩定。

dialogue.explanationZh: 否定一夜消失不否定漸減，也不能刪延續的事實。

speaking.en: The habit did not fade into thin air overnight; its place in our routine changed over several years.
speaking.zh: 習慣並非一夜消散；它在日常中的位置經幾年改變。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再保留否定及逐漸變化。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你曾在夏令營承諾每周練習觀察畫畫，回家後先是隔周、再幾個月才一次，最後不再練。你想誠實描述決心逐漸消退，並從一次短練習重新開始，不編一個突然失去興趣的晚上。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以練習間隔增長至停下說明漸變，保留重啟的具體一步，不把否定一夜消失讀成從未減弱。

examples.en: My intention to practise faded into thin air as the gaps between drawing sessions grew longer. I want to begin again with one short observation sketch.
examples.zh: 畫畫練習相隔越來越久，我原先的決心逐漸消散。我想從一次短觀察速寫重新開始。

examples.en: The commitment did not fade into thin air in a single evening; I let the practice become less frequent until it stopped. This week I will set aside ten minutes to draw.
examples.zh: 決心並非一晚就消散；我讓練習越來越少，直到停下。這周我會留十分鐘畫畫。

takeaways.en: The early excitement faded into thin air as we stopped making time for the project.
takeaways.zh: 我們不再為項目留時間時，初期興奮逐漸消散。

takeaways.en: Their influence did not fade into thin air overnight; traces remained in later work.
takeaways.zh: 他們的影響並非一夜消散，後來作品仍留痕跡。

titleZh: 分走原本屬於別人的風頭

brief.meaningEn: Take away some attention or impact that another person or event was expected to receive.
brief.meaningZh: 分走另一人或活動原本預期得到的部分注意或影響力。
brief.grammar: steal some thunder from + person/event; stole in past, has stolen in perfect; some limits the amount.
brief.register: Contextual adaptation of the established idiom steal someone’s thunder. Thunder here means attention or impact, not weather.
brief.boundaryZh: 不必表示抄襲、偷作品或故意傷害，也未必把對方全部風頭奪走；要看實際注意分配。
brief.misconceptionZh: 同時獲注意不一定是搶風頭，需原本預期與注意被分走的關聯。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述注意競爭，保留程度及意圖未明的界限。

sources.sentence: The online launch may steal some thunder from the printed edition.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 15, table 1, row 8; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The surprise guest’s announcement stole some thunder from the exhibition opening: several reporters turned to ask her questions before returning to the curator’s planned remarks.
listening.zh: 驚喜來賓的宣布分走展覽開幕的部分風頭：幾位記者先轉向問她，再回到策展人原定發言。
listening.promptZh: stole some thunder 描述甚麼？

options.en: Some expected attention shifted from the opening remarks to the guest.
options.zh: 原本給開幕發言的部分注意轉向來賓。

options.en: The guest copied the curator’s artwork and claimed authorship.
options.zh: 來賓抄策展人的作品，並聲稱自己創作。

options.en: No reporter returned to the curator at any point.
options.zh: 沒有記者曾回到策展人那邊。

options.en: The curator had planned to give the whole speaking slot to the guest.
options.zh: 策展人原定把整段發言時間給來賓。

listening.explanationZh: 記者先轉問再回來，支持部分注意被分走，未給抄襲或全不返回。

reply.promptZh: 來賓宣布後，為甚麼開幕發言的注意被分散？
reply.promptEn: Why was attention diverted from the opening remarks after the guest spoke?

options.en: Several reporters turned to the guest with questions before returning to the curator.
options.zh: 幾位記者先轉問來賓，再回到策展人。

options.en: Her announcement stole some thunder from the opening by drawing reporters away for a while.
options.zh: 她的宣布暫時吸走記者，分走開幕的部分風頭。

options.en: The planned remarks briefly shared the reporters’ attention with the unexpected news.
options.zh: 原定發言短暫與意外消息分佔記者注意。

options.en: Some attention shifted to her news instead of staying with the planned opening.
options.zh: 部分注意轉到她的消息，沒有一直留在原定開幕。

reply.explanationZh: 四句給具體注意轉移，沒有由效果猜故意搶場。

scene.promptZh: 頒獎前有人公布另一項大型活動，現場不少人開始追問新活動，原定得獎者介紹暫受冷落。哪句貼切？

options.en: The new announcement stole some thunder from the award presentation.
options.zh: 新宣布分走頒獎的部分風頭。

options.en: The audience stayed focused solely on the award presentation.
options.zh: 觀眾一直只專注頒獎。

options.en: The announcement had been the planned introduction to the winning work.
options.zh: 該宣布原本就是得獎作品的預定介紹。

scene.explanationZh: 新活動引走注意，是原定頒獎受分散，不是一直專注或本來介紹。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 stole some thunder 得出？

options.en: Some expected attention was diverted.
options.zh: 部分原本預期的注意被分走。

options.en: The person necessarily copied someone’s work and intended to cause harm.
options.zh: 當事人必定抄作品，而且有意傷害。

options.en: The context should show whose expected attention was affected.
options.zh: 情境應顯示誰原本預期的注意受影響。

contrast.explanationZh: 效果不自動證明抄襲或惡意；some 亦非全奪。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想由記者暫時轉問來賓，就報作她蓄意破壞開幕；你沒有動機資料。哪句較準確？

options.en: Describe the temporary shift in attention without presenting an unverified intention as fact.
options.zh: 描述注意暫移，不把未核實意圖當事實。

options.en: Use the attention shift as confirmation that she planned to embarrass the curator.
options.zh: 把注意轉移當她計劃令策展人尷尬的確認。

options.en: So the curator never resumed the remarks after the reporters turned to the guest?
options.zh: 所以記者轉向來賓後，策展人就沒有恢復發言嗎？

dialogue.explanationZh: 記者後來回到策展人，支持暫時分走注意；不能說未恢復，也未有蓄意羞辱的證據。

speaking.en: The announcement stole some thunder from the presentation, but I do not know whether that was intended.
speaking.zh: 宣布分走介紹的部分風頭，但我不知道是否有意。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清注意效果及動機。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你打算在家庭聚會介紹妹妹完成的短片，卻先展示自己旅遊的意外照片，大家追問照片很久，妹妹還未介紹。你想承認自己分走注意，並把話題交回她，不說照片不好或替大家猜惡意。用一至兩句英文回應。
writing.selfCheckZh: 承認照片討論分走介紹的注意，提出實際交回話題；不把無意當沒影響，也不把照片本身價值與場合混淆。

examples.en: My travel photos stole some thunder from my sister’s film introduction, and I should give her the floor now. Let’s hear how she made it.
examples.zh: 我的旅遊照片分走妹妹短片介紹的部分風頭，我現在應把發言交給她。我們聽聽她怎樣拍。

examples.en: I did not mean to steal some thunder from her film, but the photo discussion has taken over the moment. I will put the pictures aside and invite her to begin.
examples.zh: 我不是有意分走她短片的風頭，但照片討論已佔了這一刻。我會先放下照片，請她開始。

takeaways.en: The surprise announcement stole some thunder from the planned launch.
takeaways.zh: 意外宣布分走原定發布的部分風頭。

takeaways.en: I worried that my news might steal some thunder from her presentation, so I waited until she had finished.
takeaways.zh: 我擔心自己的消息會分走她介紹的部分風頭，所以等她完成。

brief.meaningEn: Assume control of or responsibility for work previously handled by someone else.
brief.meaningZh: 接手原由別人負責的工作或管理責任。
brief.grammar: take over from someone; take over a task; took in past, has taken in perfect. Specify responsibility and duration where known. Software can take over repetitive tasks previously done by people; the subject identifies what now handles the specified work. An object such as everything specifies the full scope; helping without taking over everything does not mean that no limited task was transferred.
brief.register: Common phrasal verb. This lesson is responsibility/control, not buying a company or a feeling dominating someone. A software subject can describe replacement in a task without attributing human intentions or claiming that every duty has been transferred.
brief.boundaryZh: 接手不一定永久、未必由於對方失職，也不等於只從旁協助；需交代誰負責決定及工作。 軟件也可接手原由人處理的指定工作；這不代表它有人的意圖，或所有職責都已轉交。
brief.misconceptionZh: 在旁看或給建議，不必然已接過責任。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說清接手範圍、人物及時間，不加入未證實人事原因。
